component: MO2Headless (transactional GUI-free Mod Organizer 2 instance controller)
purpose: Hardening package 1 of the 2026-09-01 brief: put plugin enable-state preservation inside `run` so no script copy can drop markers again (#105, audit F0/F2); stamp every mutated instance with the build and refuse older builds (#105 F0); keep priority and enabled state on --replace (#91 F13).

build.method: GitHub Actions build.yml (ModOrganizer2/build-with-mob-action) - this workstation has no Qt SDK
build.sequenceMeaning: committer epoch of the built commit, injected by CMake as MO2_HEADLESS_BUILD_SEQUENCE; the instance stamp compares it
build.lint: clang-format per fork .clang-format, checked locally with LLVM 19.1.5 and by the Lint workflow

behavior.runPreservesPlugins: snapshot active set under the lock; after the child exits re-enable every previously active plugin still in the effective tree (child keeps order); append dropped-but-existing ones; report missing; journal as run-preserve-plugins; emit stateDelta; --no-preserve-plugins opts out; timeout returns exit 75 JSON
behavior.versionStamp: headless/controller.version {version, hash, sequence, stampedAt, command} on every mutating verb; exit 78 when the stamp is newer; --allow-older-controller overrides; status reports controllerBuild + instanceStamp
behavior.replace: --replace keeps the replaced row's priority and enabled state unless --priority/--enable/--disable are given; result has replaced/previousPriority/previousEnabled

featureDefaultsDiff.note: not applicable - controller, no runtime feature configuration; defaults are the verbs' documented behaviour above

validation.live: status/audit/plugin-list (235/231)/mod-list (308) ok; install_mod --verify 0 problems; preflight clean; mod-enable + mod-disable Light Placer journaled and stamped; smoke launch_verify PASS 2026-09-01 23:11 (records/launch-verify-20260901-231117.md) through `run`
